root_cause.evidence: The patch initializes `struct net_device *netdev = NULL;` to avoid using an undefined value, and changes the error print from `ERR_PTR(urb->status)` to `ERR_PTR(rc)` to report the correct error code. The commit message states: "In the case of a short read where netdev has not yet been assigned, initialize as NULL to avoid dereferencing an undefined value. Also report the error value of the failed resubmit."
